rationale: The original candidate and exactly two eligible advisory inputs target the same lesson version and frozen commit. They supply the required academic and learning-design roles across two distinct disclosed runs and two declared provider/model families; one approves and one requests changes. This is an internally consistent, operator-attested review-input gate, not verified independence. The bounded final revision resolves both academic major findings, the academic minor, the glossary scene-link omission, and the worked-example prompt omission while preserving the two positive learning-design findings. The sole unincorporated minor terminology recommendation would introduce inaccurate context-specific wording or unverified schema structure, while the retained definition preserves the same scientific sense. Static academic, assessment, claim-source, accessibility, privacy, security, and rights checks found no remaining content blocker. Merge is therefore justified subject to the listed operator stamping, validation, transport, and publication-transition conditions.
